data.rationale: The proposal captures the right sequence of sites and goal, but it is vague on key constraints (first hotel with review score of 8 or more, two separate Viator searches, noting the first evening time, and the don't-click rules) and it misnames or merges parameters (activity queries, dinner date and party size duplicating check-in and guests, and no companion name for the "Hi {companion}" greeting), so an automation would need guesswork.
